description: This file defines the class 'SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase' which manages initialization, schema migration, and transaction handling for a SQLite database within the Chromium project. It includes method declarations for database setup, migration, committing changes, and error handling, and references various external classes and functions related to database operations, threading, and file management.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A thread-safe reference-counted class that manages the lifecycle, schema migration, and transaction commits for a SQLite database, designed for use within the Chromium project.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Posts a task to flush pending database operations in the background; runs callback when done.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Commits pending operations and closes the database, to be called before destruction.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before each commit operation.

methods.name: InitializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database on a background thread, including schema migration and setup.

methods.name: RecordOpenDBProblem
methods.description: Virtual method to record metrics for database open problems.

methods.name: RecordDBMigrationProblem
methods.description: Virtual method to record metrics for database migration issues.

methods.name: DoMigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual method for subclass-specific database schema migration; returns new version or nullopt on error.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual method for creating or verifying database schema; returns success status.

methods.name: DoInitializeDatabase
methods.description: Virtual method for additional database initialization tasks; default returns true.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets and resets the database and meta table, e.g., after errors.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits pending database operations, invoking the pre-commit callback.

methods.name: DoCommit
methods.description: Pure virtual method for subclass-specific commit logic.

methods.name: PostBackgroundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the background thread.

methods.name: PostClientTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the client thread.

methods.name: db
methods.description: Accessor for the underlying sql::Database object.
